description: A shop that keeps its stock and takes orders for its products.
data: products with a name (unique), a price and the number in stock
orders of one product with a quantity, the total price and a status (placed or cancelled)
actions: the owner adds products and changes their price or stock
rules: an order cannot be for more than is in stock
placing an order takes the items out of stock
cancelling an order puts the items back
the total is worked out by the system
prices must be more than zero and stock cannot be negative
